cases.name: serve into kitchen
cases.text: Aim beyond the kitchen into the diagonal service box.

cases.name: serve into wrong service box
cases.text: Aim across the net into the opposite service box.

cases.name: sideline miss
cases.text: Square the paddle face slightly to keep the next shot inside the sideline.

cases.name: baseline miss
cases.text: Square the paddle face slightly to keep the next shot inside the sideline.

cases.name: failed net clearance
cases.text: Open the paddle face slightly to clear the net.

cases.name: receiver misses second bounce
cases.text: Move toward the incoming ball and return it after one bounce.

cases.name: early return volley
cases.text: Let the serve and return bounce before volleying.

cases.name: kitchen volley
cases.text: Move fully behind the kitchen line before a volley.
